title: Symfony UX 3.7 released
content:
<html><head></head><body>Symfony UX 3.7 is out, with more than 100 pull requests merged since 3.6. It
adds UX CSS, an experimental package that turns design tokens into atomic CSS,
two self-hosted image servers to UX Image, and takes the UX Toolkit out of
experimental. LiveComponent…</body></html>
author: Hugo Alliaume
